stages.title: Transcript Triage & Signal Classification
selection_criteria: Strict verbatim quote anchoring without hallucinated requirements
best_practices: Always anchor extracted requirements, research items, and non-goals to verbatim speaker quotes and utterance timestamps.
Treat auto-generated meeting summaries as unverified hints; extract only from raw transcript turns.
Separate explicit speaker consensus from contested points and open research items before generating specs.

stages.title: Deep Research & Technical Tradeoff Synthesis
selection_criteria: Accurate web/documentation synthesis with source citations
Bounded exploration under strict time and token budgets
Clear separation of low-risk technical defaults vs high-impact product choices
best_practices: Timebox each open-to-research question and cap search fan-out to avoid research loops.
Require primary documentation citations (official API docs, RFCs, or package registries) for every recommendation.
Pre-fill low-risk technical choices for review, but pause at Gate 1 whenever pricing, auth, data ownership, or scope is affected.

stages.title: Consensus Promotion & Requirements Specification
selection_criteria: Deterministic traceability from quote_id and research_id to requirement_id
Strict negative-constraint enforcement for out-of-scope items
best_practices: Promote only multi-speaker or decision-maker-confirmed items into locked requirements (`REQ-*`).
Emit explicit negative constraints (`Out of scope`) and regression invariants (`Must not regress`) alongside acceptance criteria.
Require Gate 1 human approval before transitioning locked requirements into application code generation.

stages.title: System Architecture & Edge/Storage Blueprint
selection_criteria: Boundary clarity across swappable provider adapters
Clean schema design for Cloudflare Workers, R2, and relational state
Minimal complexity and zero speculative abstractions
best_practices: Isolate external integrations (booking, calendar, call, transcript, repo, deploy) behind typed adapter interfaces.
Model Cloudflare R2 keys, webhook idempotency keys, and correlation keys explicitly before writing handlers.
Default to a single well-tested vertical slice when spinning up greenfield apps; use delta branches for follow-up meetings.

stages.title: Full-Stack Web App Implementation (Gemini on Antigravity)
selection_criteria: Pinned strictly to Gemini models on Antigravity per platform policy
Ordered quota-aware fallback chain across Gemini 4 tiers
High multi-file TypeScript/Next.js/Cloudflare Workers and Python/FastAPI accuracy
best_practices: Scaffold against golden templates (Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + Cloudflare Workers/R2, or FastAPI + React/Vite when Python is constrained).
Keep each feature vertical end-to-end: schema, API route, UI state, error state, and automated test.
If a Gemini tier hits a 5-hour or weekly quota limit mid-run, step down cleanly to the next Gemini fallback model while preserving the Antigravity conversation ID.
Never embed placeholder stubs for in-scope features or commit credentials, local paths, or private network names.

stages.title: Verification, Security Scan & Cloudflare Deployment
selection_criteria: Automated build, lint, typecheck, and headless smoke-test execution
Zero-leak scanning before git push and Cloudflare Worker/R2 deploy
best_practices: Run typecheck, build, unit tests, HTTP health probes, and zero-leak secret/PII scans before opening Gate 2.
Verify R2 bucket bindings, Worker routes, and environment variables in preview environments prior to production promotion.
Open changes on `feat/<slice>` or `delta/<meeting-id>` branches; never push directly to `main`.
